articles.title: NEWS RECEIVED FROM HARYANA STATE UNDER THE LEADERSHIP OF C.M.SH.NAYAB SINGH SAINI
articles.summary: Nayab Singh Saini’s visit to Singapore, aimed at further strengthening Haryana’s identity on the global investment map, concluded with significant achievements. During the visit, various companies and institutions agreed to sign Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) for investment proposals worth approximately Rs 5,500 crore in Haryana.
